articles.title: Ukraine will stop hitting refineries if Russia halts energy attacks, Zelenskiy says
articles.summary: He made the offer after Trump demanded Kyiv stop attacking Russian oil facilities and blamed those strikes for high U.S. diesel prices.

articles.title: Trump calls for replacing Ukraine's Zelenskiy in tussle over diesel deal with Russia
articles.summary: Zelenskiy said a Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia killed 20 people, including three children, after Washington lifted sanctions on Russian diesel.

articles.title: Yemen's Houthis renew warning over Saudi airports after deadly Riyadh attack
articles.summary: The warning followed an attack on Riyadh’s international airport that killed 12 people and injured more than 300.

articles.title: US military says it disabled cargo vessel trying to run Iran blockade
articles.summary: U.S. Central Command said a fighter jet hit the Panama-flagged M/V Ocean Molica in the Gulf of Oman without harming its crew after it ignored warnings.

articles.title: Vice President of RS on Election Results: Bosniaks Are Politically Marginalized in Republika Srpska, We Lost the Protection Mechanism
articles.summary: Vice President Ćamil Duraković warned that the results weakened Bosniak representation and safeguards for vital national interests in the entity.

articles.title: Kos Says Her Vision Is for Western Balkans to Become Part of EU One Day
articles.summary: At a transport conference in Sofia, Commissioner Kos pointed to more than 130 regional road, rail and border-crossing projects.

articles.title: “Nova” staff accuse the new owner of imposing a chief editor just ahead of the election
articles.summary: Employees resisted owner Pedro Vargas Santos David’s appointment of Marko Stjepanović after the dismissal of Nova’s editor-in-chief.

articles.title: Ukrainian journalist says Austrian police held him at gunpoint, accused him of spying for Kyiv
articles.summary: Mykhailo Tkach said masked officers smashed his car windows in Vienna; his cameraman remained in custody when he spoke.

articles.title: Azerbaijan students launch school strike over hijab restrictions
articles.summary: The Baku education department announced school monitoring visits as pupils at two schools boycotted classes over restrictions on hijabs.

articles.title: Former First Deputy Chairman of National Security Committee Avazov and ex-Minister of Health Dosmambetov detained
articles.summary: The Military Prosecutor’s Office confirmed the detentions to AKIpress, but the publicly visible report did not specify any charges.

articles.title: Polish security services meet following threat to PM and defence minister
articles.summary: The interior minister and security services coordinator ordered a meeting at the Internal Security Agency’s counter-terrorism centre after police received the information.

articles.title: Video. Police clash with protesters in Brussels as thousands march against spending cuts
articles.summary: Police estimated that 30,000 people attended the trade union march and said more than 100 were detained after clashes on its sidelines.

articles.title: Palestinian President Abbas postpones legislative elections until 2027
articles.summary: A presidential decree cited security and logistical obstacles and moved the planned November 2026 vote to September 2027.

articles.title: Iran executed over 2,000 people in past year, rights group says
articles.summary: Rights group HRANA counted 2,003 executions from October 10, 2025 through October 8, 2026, up from 1,553 in the preceding year.

articles.title: Flydubai co-pilot planned suicide attack in Israel inspired by 9/11
articles.summary: Authorities said the Omani co-pilot had previously been barred from flying in Oman because of extremist views.

articles.title: Vessel struck by unknown projectile off UAE coast amid surge in attacks, UKMTO says
articles.summary: The Panama-flagged crude tanker GEM NO.2 reported a fire that was extinguished; authorities had not identified who fired the projectile.

articles.title: WHO unsure what caused pneumonia that killed plague-lab worker in Russia
articles.summary: The WHO said tests on the worker and her contacts were negative for the high-threat pathogens checked, and it found no evidence of ongoing transmission.

articles.title: Middle East war, high debt levels to dominate IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok
articles.summary: The annual IMF and World Bank meetings are being held outside Washington for the first time in three years, with rising energy prices adding pressure to global growth.
